request.style: English, solemn female solo voice, organ, strings, piano, low brass, reverent and majestic mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Praise awaits in silence O God
In Zion the vow shall be met
You hear the prayer of all flesh
Iniquity overwhelms the breast

[Pre-Chorus]
You atone for our transgressions
Your mercy covers our offenses
We dwell near you in your courts
Filled with goodness and sweet sports

[Chorus]
Blessed is the one you choose
Brought near to dwell with you
Filled with the goodness of your house
The holiness of your temple too

[Verse]
Awesome deeds of righteousness
Answer us O our salvation
Hope of all ends of the earth
And the farthest deep waters

[Chorus]
Blessed is the one you choose
Brought near to dwell with you
Filled with the goodness of your house
The holiness of your temple too

[Bridge]
You set the mountains in place
Girded with mighty power
You still the roaring of the seas
And the tumult of the peoples

[Chorus]
Blessed is the one you choose
Brought near to dwell with you
Filled with the goodness of your house
The holiness of your temple too

[Outro]
Blessed is the one you choose
Brought near to dwell with you
